SAMPLES OF MY WORK

CONTACT

Building Trust with My Clients

With over 40 years servicing the public Bob has experience in a variety of skills for home maintenance and repair.  Services include home watch & property management while you are away.    Weeky, monthly or seasonal services available.  

                                                                          Insured.

​

      Dependable & Time Efficient            Senior Friendly

 Home Watch       Services

Home watch services while you are away.  Monthly/Bimonthly or on demand.  Security & visual checks.  Temperature monitoring.

 

     Painting

Interior room painting, wall repairs.  

 

       Plumbing        Repairs

Repair & replace faucets; Install new sprayers; clear drains & repair leaks; pool pumps repairs

Installations of Shelving & TV Mounting

New Home & existing replacements of shelving, TV Mounting and wall installations.  Picture hanging.

Customer Feedback:
   Electrical Repairs

Small repairs to outlets or plugs. Light bulb changes on high ceilings and electrical fans repair & installation.  Ring Plus doorbell installation.

 

Unusual Requests

Give me a call to discuss any unusal requests for assistance.   Ikea or adjustable bed assembly.
